subject: Follow-up: Pen Test Findings — Evidence of Remediation and Compensating Controls
messages:
From: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@fintech-co.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Ross <tim.ross@fintech-co.com>, Chris Lang <chris.lang@secfirm.io>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Initial: Pen test report request and remediation evidence

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for arranging the third-party pen test last month. Our security team has a couple of follow-ups before we can close our SIG submission: primarily we need the full pen test report (redacted is OK for IP), scope confirmation showing which subnets and environments were tested, and evidence that the high/critical items have been addressed.

Specifically can you provide: 
- The PDF pen test report or a link to download it
- A short scope statement (which services, internal/external, and timeframe)
- For the top 3 findings (these were SQLi, auth token exposure, and insecure CORS), screenshots/configs/ticket references showing remediation or compensating controls

We understand some stuff may be sensitive; redaction is fine, but we do require artifact-level evidence (screenshots, Jira/INC numbers, or config snippets).

Can you confirm ETA? Our SIG submission is due 02/20.

Best,
Claire
Claire Bennett
Head of Security, FinTech Co

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@fintech-co.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Pen test report request and remediation evidence

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear list. I can confirm we engaged SecFirm (Chris on cc) for the pentest and we have a scope doc plus the report. Quick answers up front:
- Report: redacted PDF OK — we will provide a redacted copy of the full report.
- Scope: external perimeter (api.redwood.com), staging (isolated VPC), and a limited internal service set (inference-gateway, auth-service) were in scope — tests ran 2026-01-10 to 2026-01-14.
- Top 3 findings: we’ve opened tickets and applied fixes for SQLi (INC-4521), rotated tokens and tightened storage for auth artifacts (INC-4524), and tightened CORS policies with rule changes (PR-789).

I will assemble the artifacts (screenshots of firewall/NGINX config, Jira/INC links, and the redacted report). ETA: by COB Monday (2026-02-15). If you need anything earlier for the SIG, let me know which artifact to prioritize.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Chris Lang <chris.lang@secfirm.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@fintech-co.com>
Cc: Tim Ross <tim.ross@fintech-co.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 08:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Pen test report request and remediation evidence

Hi all,

SecFirm confirms the redacted report is greenlighted for sharing. Scope confirmation: external blackbox against api.redwood.com; staging internal tests in isolated VPC (no access to customer data); credentialed checks against auth-service. Timeframe: 2026-01-10 through 2026-01-14.

Note on findings: the SQLi was "high" due to an input sanitization gap on a deprecated debug endpoint; that endpoint has been removed in production and a filter added in staging. Auth token storage issue was classified as "critical" because of ephemeral token logging to a debug stream; token logs were purged, logging path removed, and secrets rotated. For CORS, we recommended host whitelist + stricter header checks — implemented as described by Redwood infra.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call if the FinTech Sec team wants to walk through the report.

- Chris
Chris Lang
Lead Consultant, SecFirm

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2026 09:26:00 -08:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Collate artifacts for FinTech Co — INC-4521/4524/PR-789

Team — compiling artifacts to send Claire. Draft package includes:
- redacted pen-test PDF (2026-02-15-pt-summary.pdf)
- INC-4521: ticket link + fix screenshot (ticket-INC-4521-sql-injection-fix.png) showing request validation applied to legacy endpoint
- INC-4524: secret rotation audit log (log-redaction-4524.txt) and confirmation of purge (Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4524)
- PR-789: firewall/CORS rule screenshot (config-screenshot-firewall-rules.png) and PR link
- mitigations matrix (mitigations-matrix.xlsx) listing compensating controls: WAF rules, runtime input sanitization, and strengthened logging retention policies

A few notes: the secret rotation audit contains partial identifiers — legal has okayed redaction to remove full key values. Laura, can you confirm redaction level acceptable to FinTech? Markus — can you add the SLA note (outage window) we used for the patch deployment?

I'll attach artifacts and draft the response. Target to send to Claire by 15:00 PT today.

Monica
Security Solutions, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Claire Bennett <claire.bennett@fintech-co.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Chris Lang <chris.lang@secfirm.io>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 15:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Pen test report request and remediation evidence — artifacts attached

Claire,

Attached is the package we discussed: redacted pen-test report (2026-02-15-pt-summary.pdf) and individual artifacts for the top three findings. Attachment list below and downloadable copy: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/fintechco/pt-artifacts/

Attachments included:
- 2026-02-15-pt-summary.pdf (redacted pen-test report; SecFirm approved redactions)
- ticket-INC-4521-sql-injection-fix.png (screenshot of code review and NGINX request validation rule applied)
- ticket-INC-4524-secret-rotation-log.txt (audit snippet showing rotation event; sensitive values redacted)
- config-screenshot-firewall-rules.png (CORS whitelist and WAF rule snippet)
- mitigations-matrix.xlsx (summary of compensating controls and monitoring)

Summary of compensating controls for SIG:
- WAF rules blocking common SQLi payloads at edge (rule IDs: WAF-134, WAF-137).
- Runtime input sanitization library added to legacy endpoints pending full deprecation.
- Token lifecycle hardened: rotation, revoked tokens purge, and new storage with KMS encryption.
- Additional logging retention policy: security logs retained 365 days for audit, with redaction of secrets in logs.

Related tickets/links:
- INC-4521: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4521
- INC-4524: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4524
- PR-789 (CORS fix): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PR-789

If you need any of the attachments in a different format or need us to mask additional fields, tell us which items you prefer redacted and we will adjust. We can also schedule a 30-min walkthrough with SecFirm and our infra team.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation so we can close this out ahead of your SIG submission.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0186
